AGENDA
  GLENDALE PLANNING HEARING OFFICER
  (STAFF ACCESS ONLY) MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E. Broadway,
  Room 105, Glendale, CA 91206

 Welcome to the meeting of the Planning Hearing Officer. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and
 rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. Meetings are archived on the City Website
 for viewing anytime at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes-10259. If you have any question about
 matters on the agenda, or any requests for assistance, please contact the Community Development Department at (818)
 548-2115 during regular business hours. All documents related to items on this agenda that are received prior to this
 meeting, and are public records, will be available by contacting the Planning Division at 818-548-2115. The staff report and
 case materials will be available before the hearing date at www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes-10259.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and
 Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48
 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription
 services.

  WEDNESDAY, MAY 13, 2020, AT 9:30 A.M.
Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from the LA
County Health Department, the Planning Commission hearing will be available to the public electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is encouraged to
watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
  On local cable TV: Charter Cable Channel 6.
  Streaming Online:
  https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/management-services/gtv6/live-video-stream

For public comments and questions during the meeting, please call 818-937-8100.

City staff will be submitting the questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person during the Planning
Commission hearing.

  STAFF:  Minjee Hahm
PROJECT DESCRIPTION
Application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow the continued operation of a daycare center at an
existing church located in the “R-1650” - Medium-High Density Residential Zone, described as Portion of
Lot 16, Oliver’s West Glendale Tract, in the City of Glendale, County of Los Angeles.

GLENDALE PLANNING HEARING OFFICER
GLENDALE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PUBLIC HEARING MINUTES
  MAY 13, 2020
9:30 a.m.  Ms. Milca Toledo, Planning Hearing Officer, opened the hearing in
  Room 105 of the Municipal Services Building. She outlined the
  requirements of Title 30 for the pertinent cases and described the
  provisions for appeal in Title 30 of the Glendale Municipal Code as
  well as the procedures for the conduct of the hearings.

  Ms. Toledo announced that the agenda for the meeting was posted
  on May 6, 2020, at the City Hall Entrance.

Staff Members Present – Community Development Department
1) Milca Toledo, Planning Hearing Officer
2) Minjee Hahm, Planning Assistant

(1) LOCATION:  626 NORTH PACIFIC AVENUE
   CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. PCUP 1828110

APPLICANT:  Samuel Oh

PROJECT DESCRIPTION
Application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow the continued operation of a
daycare center at an existing church located in the “R-1650” - (Medium-High
Density Residential) Zone, described as Portion of Lot 16, Oliver’s West Glendale
Tract, in the City of Glendale, County of Los Angeles.
CODE REQUIRES
(1) The operation of a daycare center within a church or other house of worship
  religiously affiliated or nonsectarian preschool requires a Conditional Use
  Permit in the R-1650 zone.

APPLICANT’S PROPOSAL
(1) To allow the continued operation of a daycare center at an existing church.

ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
The project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 1 “Existing Facilities”
exemption pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15301 because this project
is proposing to allow the continued operation of an existing daycare center within
an existing church and involves no expansion of the use or building.
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  2
May 13, 2020

Staff
- Ms. Minjee Hahm, Associate Planner, overviewed the staff report. She answered
questions from the Planning Hearing Officer.

Applicant (via teleconference)
- Mr. Samuel Oh, applicant and representing the owner, presented the case.

WRITTEN PUBLIC INPUT
In Favor:  None
Interested Party: None.
In Opposition:  None.

SPEAKING AT THE HEARING
In Favor:  No one.
In Opposition:  No one.
Interested Party: No one.

The case was taken under consideration for a determination to be made at a
later date.

The meeting adjourned at 10:00 a.m.
